item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

Super Saturated (SS) hydration is independently repeated by two credited retailer accounts: A04 reports strong hydration before makeup, and A08 reports hydrated skin while using SS with tretinoin and other actives. Their shared proposition is reported hydration during use, not demonstrated standalone efficacy. Neither specific condition is independently repeated. A09 separately reports Avant Guard mask plus SS hydration retention, with no separable allocation between products. This joint outcome is isolated. No direct hydration opposition is observed in readable accounts; A07 remains unassessable. There is no cross-venue corroboration of SS hydration, measured efficacy, prevalence or established causation. Formula versions are unknown.

Texture varies by attribute and comparator: A04 reports lightweight, refreshing, fast-drying SS without a clogged-pore feeling; A03 says Wave Serum is less sticky than SS. Each precise proposition has one account. These reports qualify a uniformly favorable texture claim but are compatible: lightweight and relatively sticky can coexist. A03’s independence posture is unavailable. No focal non-user texture speculation or agreeing replies are supplied.

Behavior consequences: A03 continues SS despite relative stickiness, citing a tentative belief that SS contains more glycerin; this is continued use with an uncertain reported reason, not hydration testimony or repurchase. A04 ordered SS after a sister’s introduction and subsequently bought Buffer Jelly seeking greater nighttime hydration/repair, then face wash and mesh moisturizer. This preserves daytime satisfaction alongside desire for more nighttime support; it establishes neither SS abandonment nor explicit SS repurchase. 'Refill' metadata cannot supply repurchase. A09 deducted one star for mask fit on a very small head, especially the nose; no return or remedy purchase is narrated. No other focal repurchase or remedy action is explicit.

Other-product findings remain separate: A04 reports Buffer Jelly morning glow/clean-looking skin and small quantity needed; the face wash reportedly removes makeup, hydrates and ends breakouts. A10 reports Buffer Jelly retaining unspecified hydrating products when used as the final nighttime step, with morning glow and little product needed. Neither account’s other-product outcomes corroborate SS-specific performance; A10 does not name SS.

Raw engagement: A03 has Reddit native score 6, observation time unavailable, explicitly not interpreted and marked not materially positive.
